U_0x00C2BD: The top model of the Barrelion line, developed from the Barrelion Custom. It mounts two Big Head Railguns for greater firepower, with further reinforced armor and mobility. Though it looks like a large artillery piece, it can fly on its own via its <Tesla Drive>. Its armor is reinforced by a T-Dot Array, yielding a sturdy frame from minimal material and a simple, cheap, maintainable design.
U_0x00C5C6: A mass-produced <Armored Module> used by the <DC> and <Colony Integ. Army> in the <DC War>. <Isurugi Heavy Ind.> still produces it, and it serves both <DC> remnants and the <Earth Fed Army> (Federation type RAM-006). Built to fight humanoid weapons, it is a versatile high-performance unit tough enough for local battles too. Fielded as a commander's <Armored Module>, it is a fast battlefield-control unit that keeps pace with Lion formations. Its <Tesla Drive>, a reaction thruster separating gravitational and inertial mass, shapes the T-Dot Array into a repulsion field - the unit's 'shield.' LIEON-system limb control fixes the weapon shortage of the Lion and Barrelion, allowing melee blades and other arms. A cheaper variant omits the command functions.
U_0x00CB38: The mercenary Murata's machine, based on the Guarlion Custom. Large shoulder boosters raise its burst and charging power; with reinforced armor and the Shishioh Blade, it excels at sword combat.
U_0x00CC9B: A space-combat model of the mass-production Valsion (Valsion Kai). It swaps the pre-production type's flexible arms for booster units and reinforces the armor. Extra verniers tune it for space, but it fights under gravity too.
U_0x00CE4C: An update of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>'s multirole fighter. Built for any theater, it fights at any altitude and hauls heavy payloads. Flexible special-material wings, a buried cockpit, and long-TBO modules set it apart.
U_0x00CFEE: <Earth Fed Army> main tank with a large railgun.
